findings.summary: Implementation of Requirement R2 (repo_context.json validation) in Milestone M1 is effectively blocked by Open Question Q1 (target ecosystems/validators), as acknowledged in Synthesis Warning W2. The foundation deliverables cannot be fully specified until this question is resolved.

evidence.quote: The Implementation Council subsystem SHALL define and require a typed, versioned repo_context.json schema
Intake & DAG Work Planner (C12) with input validation (plan_package_final.json, repo_context.json, workspace_context.json)...

Blocking open questions Q1 (target ecosystems) and Q2 (workspace backend) must be resolved before Phase 1 can begin

findings.summary: Implementation of Requirement R3 (workspace_context.json validation) in Milestone M1 is effectively blocked by Open Question Q2 (workspace backend), as acknowledged in Synthesis Warning W2. The workspace design in C22 and C12 cannot be solidified until this question is resolved.

evidence.quote: The Implementation Council subsystem SHALL define and require a typed, versioned workspace_context.json schema
Workspace Manager (C22) with namespaced partitions... and checkpoint/restore support
What concrete workspace backend(s) are permitted... and what are the hard constraints...?
